fusions.name: Sly Undercut
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. A low feint with a water-slicked weapon that deals 22 damage and leaves the target [Drowning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds, then you move 20% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Mirage Shimmer
fusions.desc: A shimmer of false reflections spreads from you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 15% chance to turn each against its allies for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: False Reflection
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, 40% of the elemental damage you take is sent back at whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Puddle Vixen
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded vixen of water that fights beside you, striking for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds; anything it strikes moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.
